name: Camping Grubhof
beschreibung: Camping Grubhof is located in St. Martin bei Lofer in the Tyrolean Saalachtal valley. The resort provides spacious pitches for motorhomes, caravans, and tents, as well as several rental accommodations. The grounds feature top sanitary facilities, a fresh bakery service station, and a small grocery store. Guests have access to tennis courts, a children's playground, and a soccer field. The surrounding area is exceptionally well suited for hiking, cycling, and alpine excursions into the Loferer Steinberge mountains.
